Comparison

Runway vs Pika

A side-by-side look at Runway and Pika, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose Runway when your priority is: professional video generation and AI-assisted post-production. Choose Pika when your priority is: short-form social video with attention-grabbing effects.

Runway vs Pika at a glance

CriteriaRunwayPika
CategoryAI Video GeneratorsAI Video Generators
Best forProfessional video generation and AI-assisted post-production.Short-form social video with attention-grabbing effects.
Pricing modelFreemiumFreemium
Free planNoYes
Free trialNot verifiedNo
API availableYesNot verified
Platforms
  • Web, iOS
  • API
  • Web, iOS, Android, Discord
Key features
  • Gen-4 and Gen-4 Turbo video models with strong character and scene consistency
  • Act-One for performance capture driving generated characters
  • camera control and motion brush
  • Frames image model
  • Magic Tools (green screen/rotoscope, inpainting, super-slow-motion, depth of field, background removal)
  • video-to-video restyling
  • Text-to-video and image-to-video
  • Pikaffects (crush, melt, inflate, explode, cake-ify and similar transformations)
  • Pikadditions inserting a subject into existing footage
  • Pikaswaps replacing elements in a clip
  • Pikascenes combining multiple reference images into one scene
  • lip sync and sound effects
Advantages
  • The most professionally credible video generator here - used in actual film and advertising production
  • the Magic Tools suite (rotoscoping, motion tracking) delivers value even without generation
  • Act-One performance capture is genuinely novel
  • Gen-4 character consistency across shots is the best available.
  • The Pikaffects are genuinely distinctive and drive real social engagement - nothing else does them as well
  • very cheap entry price
  • fast generation
  • easy enough for non-technical users
Limitations
  • Expensive at any real production volume - credits evaporate quickly
  • clip length limits still force stitching for anything narrative
  • free tier is one-time only, so evaluation is limited
  • output resolution and frame rate lag conventional production standards
  • Much shallower than Runway - it does effects, not production
  • clip length is very short
  • narrative or professional use cases are poorly served
  • free tier watermarking makes it unusable for business without paying

Pricing notes

Runway

Free with roughly 125 one-time credits (no monthly refresh). Standard around $15/mo ($12 annually, 625 credits/month). Pro around $35/mo ($28 annually, 2,250 credits plus unlimited generations in Explore mode). Unlimited around $95/mo ($76 annually) with unlimited relaxed-rate generation. Enterprise custom, annual, with higher resolution, team management and indemnification. Additional credits purchasable at roughly $10 per 1,000.

Pika

Basic free with roughly 80 monthly credits and watermarked output. Standard around $10/mo ($8 annually, roughly 700 credits, no watermark). Pro around $35/mo ($28 annually, roughly 2,300 credits) with 1080p and faster generation. Fancy/Unlimited around $95/mo ($76 annually) for highest volume and priority. Annual billing roughly 20% cheaper.

Prices change often. Confirm on the official pricing pages: Runway ↗ · Pika ↗

Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between Runway and Pika?

Runway: Generative video and creative suite used in professional film and advertising production. Pika: Consumer-oriented video generator focused on fun, shareable short-form effects.

When should I choose Runway over Pika?

Runway is listed as best for: professional video generation and AI-assisted post-production. Pika is listed as best for: short-form social video with attention-grabbing effects.

Do Runway and Pika have a free plan?

Runway: No. Pika: Yes. Check each official pricing page, as plans change.
